title: Trust but Verify: Designing Region-Inhomogeneous Forward Dynamics for Discrete Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.22380v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous diffusion treats the forward process as a design space; discrete language diffusion often uses absorbing corruption, leaving context fully trusted throughout generation. This makes trust binary: corrupted context is copied as ground truth, propagating errors into generated spans. We reopen this design space by combining absorbing and uniform-mixing kernels with region-dependent rates. Missing positions follow absorbing dynamics, while context undergoes low-rate random substitution, exposing the model to observed but uncertain tokens during training. At inference, a heuristic sampler re-injects noise into suspicious context under an annealed intensity and freezes context updates late in the trajectory. An 8,000-step finetune of a pretrained 170M-parameter masked diffusion model takes under five hours on a 6 GB laptop GPU. The base model assigns roughly 50% probability to observed tokens even when they are uniform-random garbage

translated_title: 信任但需验证：为离散扩散设计区域非均匀的前向动力学
translated_abstract: 连续扩散将前向过程视为一个可设计空间；而离散语言扩散通常采用吸收式破坏，使上下文在整个生成过程中被完全信任。这使得信任成为二元的：被破坏的上下文被直接当作真值复制，从而将错误传播到生成的片段中。我们通过将吸收核与均匀混合核相结合，并采用区域相关的速率，重新打开了这一设计空间。缺失位置遵循吸收动力学，而上下文则经历低速率的随机替换，使模型在训练中接触到“已观察但不确定”的词元。在推理阶段，一种启发式采样器以退火强度向可疑上下文重新注入噪声，并在轨迹后期冻结上下文更新。对一个预训练的1.7亿参数掩码扩散模型进行8000步微调，在一块6 GB显存的笔记本GPU上仅需不到五小时。即使观察到的词元是均匀随机的垃圾内容，基础模型仍会对这些词元分配大约50%的概率。
tldr: 该论文提出区域非均匀前向动力学，通过在训练和推理阶段对可疑上下文注入低速率噪声，打破离散扩散中“完全信任上下文”的假设，从而有效抑制错误在生成过程中的传播。
